mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression through different mechanisms (benzodiazepine GABA agonism and antipsychotic dopamine antagonism), with additive sedative and psychomotor effects; perphenazine may also inhibit alprazolam metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor closely for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and impaired cognition; reduce doses if combined; educate patient on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants.
